evidence_snippets: This page explains how you can use GitHub Enterprise triggers to invoke builds in response to commits or pull requests from a GitHub Enterprise instance and explains how you can build repositories from GitHub Enterprise if your instance is hosted in a private network.
Create a GitHub Enterprise trigger to build repositories hosted on your GitHub Enterprise instance.
